Tessa / Aditya — quick internal note on tradeoffs based on Liam's numbers: 

- Batching: at median 450 tokens and spikes to 2k, target batch window 30-50ms; gives ~1.6-2.2x throughput improvement for text-gen models with continuous batching on our runtime. If they accept slightly higher p50 latency (by ~20ms) we can push batching aggressiveness and get closer to 2.5x.

- KV/prefix caching: for document summarization, dedupe the prefix embedding cache for recurring doc templates. Expect 10-18% token savings if 30% of the calls reuse prefixes.

- Quantization: recommend deploying an INT8 variant for the pilot (balanced latency/quality). INT4 (4-bit) can be viable for low-risk aggregation outputs but needs 1-2 rounds of small-scale evals on their prompts to gauge hallucination risk. Estimate cost multiplier reductions: INT8 ~0.6x, INT4 ~0.35x relative to fp16 in GPU-hours (model dependent).

I'll produce a short eval checklist (quality thresholds we care about) and a sample config for model variants.

-karthik
Senior Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
